title: Replacement pulls for a hallway cabinet
passage:
[Document 1] Form | Tallmar Home parts desk
Replacement-pull worksheet
Model code: Lark 80
Current drawer front: original / replaced locally [tick one]
Distance between screw centers: _____ mm
Surface condition: undamaged / has a visible mark around old pull
If the drawer front was replaced locally, send the measurements and a photo with this form. The model code alone may identify the wrong pull.

[Document 2] Reply from a homeowner
My Lark 80 drawer front was replaced by a local cabinet shop last winter. The hole centers are 96 mm apart. The old pull left a straight mark that is 118 mm long. The first hole is 10 mm from the left end of the mark and the second is 12 mm from the right end. The pull will be removed, but I would rather not refinish the drawer. Photo attached. May I have the same finish as before, if one is available?

[Document 3] Parts desk comparison card
All three pulls below are available in the original finish.
Heron: 96 mm between screw centers; the cover extends 11 mm beyond each screw center.
Wren: 96 mm between screw centers; the cover extends 13 mm past the left screw center and 13 mm past the right screw center.
Reed: 128 mm between screw centers; the cover extends 15 mm beyond each screw center.
A replacement must fit the existing holes. To conceal an old mark, the cover must reach at least as far as the mark at each end; the total cover length by itself is not enough.

【文件一】Tallmar Home 零件櫃檯｜表單
替換把手工作表
型號：Lark 80
目前的抽屜面板：原廠／由當地店家更換【選一個】
螺絲孔中心距：_____ 公釐
表面狀況：無損／舊把手周圍有可見痕跡
如果抽屜面板是由當地店家更換，提交本表時請附上量測結果和照片。只看型號可能會配錯把手。

【文件二】住戶回覆
我的 Lark 80 抽屜面板是去年冬天請本地木作店換的。兩個孔的中心相隔 96 公釐。舊把手留下一道長 118 公釐的直線痕跡。第一個孔中心離痕跡左端 10 公釐，第二個離右端 12 公釐。我會卸下把手，但希望不要重做抽屜表面。照片附上。如果有跟原本一樣的表面處理，可以替我配同款嗎？

【文件三】零件櫃檯｜比對卡
下列三款把手皆有原本的表面處理款式。
Heron：螺絲孔中心距 96 公釐；蓋板往每個螺絲孔的外側各延伸 11 公釐。
Wren：螺絲孔中心距 96 公釐；蓋板往左孔左側延伸 13 公釐，往右孔右側也延伸 13 公釐。
Reed：螺絲孔中心距 128 公釐；蓋板往每個螺絲孔的外側各延伸 15 公釐。
替換把手須配合既有的螺絲孔。若要遮住舊痕跡，蓋板兩端都至少要蓋到痕跡末端，只看蓋板總長度不夠。
